flags.why: The cold snap occurs around the third lunar month, often its beginning, rather than specifically its end ([school textbook](https://schoolbird.vn/textbooks/Ngu%CC%9B%CC%83%20Va%CC%86n%207%20ta%CC%A3%CC%82p%202-CTST.pdf)).
flags.fix: late-spring cold snap around the third lunar month

flags.why: Vietnamese rô-ti also includes meat browned in a pan, so defining it exclusively as meat roasted whole in an oven or on a spit teaches a false restriction ([Vietnamese cookbook](https://medialib.qlgd.edu.vn/Uploads/THU_VIEN/shn/2/506/UserFiles/Nhung-mon-an-mien-nam-duoc-ua-chuong-nguyen-thi-dieu-thao-5647fa18-9f84-4e3f-94c5-d98bd3ca75ac.pdf)).
flags.fix: meat prepared rô-ti style, by roasting or pan-browning

flags.why: This use is Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([dictionary entry](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/r%C3%B9_qu%E1%BA%BFn)).
The Southern regional label also applies to this use of rù quến ([dictionary entry](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/r%C3%B9_qu%E1%BA%BFn)).
This figurative expression has a formal, rhetorical register that the existing tag does not indicate ([dictionary entry](https://vdict.com/r%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dng%20c%E1%BB%99t%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
